title: NASA confirms 2024 warmest year on record
text: Global climate tracking stations and satellite instruments confirmed record high temperatures across continental landmasses and oceanic basins, corroborated by NOAA.

title: NASA confirms Earth will go dark for six days in December
text: A viral social media post falsely claims that NASA warned the entire world will plunge into total darkness due to a massive solar storm. NASA has made no such statement.

title: WHO reports decline in global measles immunization rates
text: The World Health Organization published official statistics indicating millions of children missed primary vaccination doses during public health disruptions.

title: Miracle lemon tea completely cures cancer in 48 hours
text: An urgent forwarded message claims that drinking boiled lemon peels kills all cancer cells faster than chemotherapy. Medical experts warn this is an unsubstantiated dangerous hoax.

title: Federal Reserve holds interest rates steady amid inflation data
text: The Federal Reserve announced its unanimous decision to maintain benchmark borrowing costs following review of consumer price index metrics.

title: Secret government chip hidden inside all new currency notes
text: Conspiracy theorists allege central banks are installing tracking microchips in banknotes to monitor citizen movements without warrants. No electronic components exist in paper legal tender.

title: James Webb Space Telescope detects atmospheric water on exoplanet
text: Spectroscopic observations collected by the James Webb Space Telescope revealed unmistakable chemical signatures of water vapor in the atmosphere of a gas giant exoplanet.

title: Drinking silver water makes human body completely immune to all viruses
text: Viral blogs claim colloidal silver acts as an all-purpose antimicrobial shield against infection. Health authorities have warned that colloidal silver has no proven efficacy and causes irreversible skin discoloration.

title: European Union passes comprehensive AI Regulation Act
text: The European Parliament voted to enact comprehensive statutory rules governing artificial intelligence deployments, imposing strict safety protocols on high-risk foundation models.

title: Bank offers free ten thousand dollars cash to everyone who shares this post
text: Social media scammers circulate fake giveaways claiming major banks are distributing free government funds to users who click unknown external links and share account numbers.

title: Renewable energy capacity expanded by fifty percent worldwide in 2023
text: The International Energy Agency published documentation indicating historic growth in solar photovoltaic installations and wind generation capacity internationally.

title: Scientists secretly create dinosaur hybrid in remote laboratory
text: Clickbait tabloid stories claim geneticists have cloned extinct prehistoric reptiles for private military operations. Paleontologists and research centers confirm this is fiction.

title: United Nations climate summit concludes with historic transition pledge
text: Delegates representing nearly two hundred nations adopted an international consensus framework addressing emission reductions and renewable transition milestones.

title: Dark eclipse to blind everyone who looks out their window tomorrow
text: Viral audio warnings advise citizens to shutter their windows claiming celestial phenomena will emit radioactive light waves causing blindness. Astronomy centers confirm the message is an internet hoax.

title: Stock market closes higher following positive corporate earnings reports
text: Major equities indices finished the trading session with solid gains led by semiconductor manufacturers and cloud enterprise software providers reporting quarterly revenues exceeding consensus estimates.

title: Secret cure for diabetes suppressed by international pharmaceutical cartel
text: An alternative wellness video claims big pharma is burying an ancient root that eliminates diabetes overnight. Endocrinology societies state type 1 and type 2 diabetes require verified therapeutic management.
